summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various enhancements and proposals, including credential management for the REST catalog and the introduction of a first-class Tag entity. Additionally, there are ongoing efforts to address license issues blocking the release of Iceberg versions 1.11.0 and 1.10.2.
highlights: Integration work and discussions related to Spark 4.1 and 4.2 features
Management of credentials for KMS/Vault in the REST catalog
Proposal for a first-class Tag entity in the REST catalog
Progress on resolving license issues for Iceberg 1.11.0 release
